text: Twenty years after a methane explosion buried the miners of Valentine Bluffs, a Canadian mining town, the mayor revives [the Valentine's Day dance that survivor Harry Warden warned them never to hold|rules|break the rule and pay]. A box of chocolates arrives [holding a human heart|images|corpses and body parts], and a killer in mining gear [begins cutting out hearts|threat|people who kill]. When the dance is cancelled, Sarah, her rival suitors T.J. and Axel and the town's other [young people|who_suffers|teenagers and young adults] hold their own party down at the mine.
